Melee Component

Melee weapon behavior with attack patterns and hit detection.

Component Weapon

Schema

JSON
{
  "meleeComponent": {}
}

Description

The Melee Component provides melee weapon behavior including attack patterns and hit detection. It handles close-range combat mechanics such as swing arcs, damage timing, and collision detection with targets.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
Melee behavior is configured through the weapon component and animator triggers.

Example

JSON
{
  "meleeComponent": {}
}
